narrative: On the bookwheel. The worn poem lies under the morning light, lacking the last leaf but one. The cat's flank covers the outer margin. A month is already struck on your own leaf beside it. No speech is on either page. On the bookwheel. The commonplace heading Verona, the pen not yet taken up. One line of names is above the query. The cat has not moved.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and did not start a speech.

entities.name: Brooke's Romeus and Juliet
entities.context: Shown on book in Verona, by morning light
